name: The fur ledger
description: A trapper's ledger of pelts and prices
journal_clip: The fur ledger: a column of marten, lynx and fox with the prices Pete paid.
read: Marten, Nov-Feb, 8 points. Lynx, Dec-Feb, 15. Red fox, Nov-Jan, 6.
Beaver, Jan-Apr, 8. Muskrat, Mar-Apr, 1. River otter, Nov-Mar, 10.
Wolf, Dec-Mar, 12. Wolverine, Nov-Mar, 20: one a world at a time.
Prices move each year; read the sked.
